background: Barclays PLC is the listed holding company of the Barclays group, a UK universal bank with a large transatlantic corporate and investment bank alongside UK retail banking and international cards.
synthesis: As a holding company its ratings sit below the banks': A from Fitch, BBB+ from S&P and Baa1 from Moody's, all stable, with the last move S&P's upgrade to BBB+ on 19 May 2023. Consolidated ratios are strong against UK majors: CET1 of 14.3% is in the top quarter, leverage of 4.9% is at the peer median, and LCR of 158% and NSFR of 136% are above their medians. LCR has fallen 20 points since 30 Jun 2025. The flagged news in the last 90 days is conduct and fraud rather than solvency: FCA attention over the collapse of a mortgage lender, and criminals posing as the bank's fraud team.
